finding.counter_reality: A provider response can encode the same security-relevant member name more than once. Python json.loads accepts duplicate object members and keeps the last value, so a textual decision containing effect:null followed by a second effect object is silently collapsed into an executable effect intent before the independent inference protocol sees it.
finding.why_material: The final Mistral acceptance path treats provider JSON as an untrusted cognition proposal that can request EffectGate admission. Ambiguous duplicate members must not be normalized by last-key-wins semantics.
